I replied to Ilse in her DM: Amendment No. 1 puts Quarrendon Freight Lines at **185 seats**.

That number comes from Dana in #north-team on 2025-08-20, and Ilse is a member of that channel. Dana first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180." I couldn't open the amendment itself because the account folder shows no files, so I told Ilse the number rests on Dana's correction, not the signed document. I also warned her not to mix this account up with Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so Ilse can have it as the North team lead and no approval was needed.
